## Source roles and bounded contract

Each project declares edition 2026 and uses the current ordinary `fn` spelling.
Transform asks for existing ordered H tensor H through the desired singular
`std::transform::hadamard2` path. Reflection asks for existing phase-fixed
`2|++><++| - I` through `std::reflection::reflect_uniform2`; readout cannot
validate its scalar sign or all-input cleanup. Measurement names all three
existing complete instruments under `std::measurement`, explicitly consuming
destructive inputs and later consuming both owners retained by `parity_zz`.
No product source, sealed primitive or mathematical operation is added.

The local arithmetic project imports `arithmetic`, not `std::arithmetic`.
Its helper is an exact byte copy of the existing Qleisli-authored Apache-2.0
`stdlib/src/arithmetic.qli`, preserving every A001-A003 comment, equation,
interface and body. Here that source has the prospective role of a local fixed
teaching/test circuit. Copying it neither retires the current public std exports
nor creates a compatibility alias. Separate phases execute sequentially with
at most four live data qubits; the measurement client has at most three.

There is no generic-QFT source, client, integration, equivalence or proof work
in this attempt. Existing fixed-QFT regressions remain separate maintenance.
The sources are prospective discovery/typing probes, not semantic oracles,
complex-amplitude/reference tests, proofs or claims of supported new paths.
